art_direction: Pearl/off-white, mineral-violet, opalescent, restrained gold define framing and transitions; move elements retain canonical recognizable color identities.
global_rules: Use existing NDS effects and verified B1 donor components before expanding renderer.
Visible charge/impact is more valuable than long delays for routine moves.
Every effect must end with original camera/BG/OBJ/fade/palette ownership and battler anchor restored.
Do not add gameplay mechanics, change battle timing semantics or alter encounter/event progression.
Keep individual move personality; cinematic archetypes are reusable sequencing scaffolds, not one universal sprite.
Specific frame durations require existing animation-script analysis and later owner runtime assessment.
User conducts all emulator/visual QA; Claude implements source and verifies CI ROM builds.

archetypes.visual_goal: A contained electrical buildup that breaks into a sharp branched strike.
archetypes.anticipation: Gather fine yellow-white arcs around attacker; tighten before release.
archetypes.atmosphere: Dim arena temporarily; favor one strong strike-driven contrast pulse instead of constant strobing.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Lightning forks converge on defender; a brief rim-lit recoil, then small fading sparks.
archetypes.color_identity: Electric attack yellows and whites remain dominant; Opal violet only in atmospheric shadows.
archetypes.sound_direction: Lock impact sound to bolt arrival, not the initial charge.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: native thunderbolt_spa plus separately verified Ranger lightning cell; do not invent emitter IDs.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Restore native BG grade, fade state and both battler sprite priorities.

archetypes.visual_goal: Dense moving spectral orb that seems to draw energy out of the surroundings.
archetypes.anticipation: Small gathering motes and an opalescent edge around a dark purple core.
archetypes.atmosphere: Violet/charcoal localized shadow tone; background returns immediately after aftermath.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Travel anchored to native projectile timing; layered circular impact and short energy residue.
archetypes.color_identity: Ghost-purple core with restrained opalescent edges; avoid generic all-violet recolor.
archetypes.sound_direction: Orb launch and arrival have distinct cues; reserve the strongest cue for contact.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: existing shadow_ball_spa plus verified glow/target ring component if render passes selection.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Do not disturb Shadow Force hidden state, keep fade and sprite cleanup ordered.

archetypes.visual_goal: A massive wave that crosses the battlefield rather than an isolated point splash.
archetypes.anticipation: Rising crest with foreground foam; water appears to move through the scene.
archetypes.atmosphere: Subtle cyan/light-blue reflections and a scrolling surge layer.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Sweep across enemy-side coverage with distributed spray and visible recession.
archetypes.color_identity: Water colors remain blue/teal; white highlights indicate moving foam.
archetypes.sound_direction: Low water surge rises before collision; hit sounds align with per-target animation events.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: native Surf BG/sprite assets first; donor foam/frame elements only after double-battle review.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Respect friendly-fire, doubles and every Surf branch before modifying stage timing.

archetypes.visual_goal: A layered combustion volume with fast core flash and long drifting embers.
archetypes.anticipation: Brief ignition and tightening flame at source.
archetypes.atmosphere: Warm localized backlight, never globally recolor unaffected HUD.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Install existing Ranger e010 fire bloom as impact accent; keep travel native where appropriate.
archetypes.color_identity: Orange-red core and brighter yellow-white hottest center; no violet flame tint by default.
archetypes.sound_direction: Launch whoosh separated from crackle and explosion impact.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: reuse ranger_fire_bloom (e010), 8 frames, 236 OBJ tiles; source installed.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Avoid overlapping two heavy sprite sheets; free B1 sprite manager before particle unload.

archetypes.visual_goal: A crystalline impact with refracted cold light and delayed shard dust.
archetypes.anticipation: Short cold accumulation, then a clean narrow stream.
archetypes.atmosphere: Cool blue ambience and transient pale highlights.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Use installed e009 ice bloom with brittle shard breakup on defender.
archetypes.color_identity: Ice-blue/cyan/white dominate; opalescent accents only as highlights.
archetypes.sound_direction: Crisp glasslike crack at impact; faint decay with dissipating sparkles.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: reuse ranger_ice_bloom (e009), 8 frames, 236 OBJ tiles; source installed.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Blizzard multi-target and alternate branches must remain valid.

archetypes.visual_goal: Sharp rising boulders with a dramatic shatter rather than generic screen shake.
archetypes.anticipation: Ground compression, lift and uneven projectile staging.
archetypes.atmosphere: Warm dust shadows and understated battlefield displacement.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Use Ranger e002 rock burst, then short falling fragments and rapid settle.
archetypes.color_identity: Natural mineral grey, rust and ochre; Opal gold only for restrained specular hits.
archetypes.sound_direction: Rock scrape while preparing; main fracture audio at sprite impact.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: reuse ranger_rock_burst (e002), 9 frames, 219 OBJ tiles; source installed.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Rock Blast repeated hits and Ancient Power Contest branch must not lose resource cleanup.

archetypes.visual_goal: A disciplined charge-release beam that keeps each element visually distinct.
archetypes.anticipation: Converging source motes leading to a high-intensity focused shot.
archetypes.atmosphere: Brief tinted background focus only at launch/impact.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Linear beam with a small target shock ring and restrained aftermath.
archetypes.color_identity: Solar Beam green/yellow, Flash Cannon steel-white, Psybeam psychedelic, Aura Sphere blue, Dragon Pulse dragon-colored; never unify all palettes.
archetypes.sound_direction: Rise in pitch while charging, sharp release, arrival sound on contact.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: prefer native beam/travel emitters; new donor ring only after proven cell/format.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Solar Beam charge turn and existing move-specific sequence logic remain untouched.

archetypes.visual_goal: Weight and environmental motion without altering combat terrain or camera logic.
archetypes.anticipation: Small ground-pressure cue ahead of the main shock.
archetypes.atmosphere: Scene-local BG displacement and dust occlusion; no weather state writes.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Multiple staggered shock peaks followed by a controlled stop.
archetypes.color_identity: Earth brown and dust-grey; no persistent palette tint.
archetypes.sound_direction: Low rumble builds, stronger transients on each visual shock.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: reuse existing Func_ShakeBg/quake sprite tasks; source-verified donor debris optional.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Restore BG offsets exactly; keep moves' gameplay terrain effects unchanged.

archetypes.visual_goal: Heavy viscous projectile breaking into corrosive droplets.
archetypes.anticipation: Unstable orb/puddle read distinct from ghost and psychic energy.
archetypes.atmosphere: Subtle dirty-violet exposure, no persistent overlay.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Splash arcs, shrinking droplets and visible decay; avoid blood-like visual treatment.
archetypes.color_identity: Poison purples and moss green accents; not solid Opal violet.
archetypes.sound_direction: Wet splat at hit; secondary low fizz without audible overstimulation.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: existing sludge_bomb_spa plus a proven converted splatter frame if useful.
archetypes.exit_invariant: No status-chance/mechanics edits, particle and sprites must clean up.

archetypes.visual_goal: Continuous battlefield atmosphere supporting moves without obscuring HUD or Pokémon.
archetypes.anticipation: Transition in locally from current battlefield lighting.
archetypes.atmosphere: Weather-specific BG/cycling: rain sheen, snow drift, sand dust; differentiate from attack-only overlay.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: Slightly intensified on compatible move impacts, then return to persistent baseline weather.
archetypes.color_identity: Weather natural palette; existing S2-D terrain owner remains authority.
archetypes.sound_direction: Looping ambience never starts or stops mechanical weather; respect existing audio owner.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: reuse verified terrain.c visual tasks first; PMD Sky reference only until compatible BG asset selected.
archetypes.exit_invariant: Never override S2-D palette cycles or edit weather rule logic; teardown when weather ends.

archetypes.visual_goal: Distinctive restrained theatrical anticipation, climax and recovery for existing signature attacks and encounters.
archetypes.anticipation: Signature-specific visual motif with brief spotlight and a memorable stage transition.
archetypes.atmosphere: Optional encounter-local backdrop after locating actual source hook; fallback to unique attack scripts.
archetypes.impact_and_aftermath: One powerful climactic impact with measured afterimage, then safe handoff to ordinary battle rendering.
archetypes.color_identity: Dialga temporal blue/steel, Palkia spatial pink-violet, Giratina spectral/distortion; use each move's native element.
archetypes.sound_direction: Dramatic accent matched to actual game trigger, no invented encounter timing.
archetypes.donor_and_native_strategy: Source-verified existing signature scripts and Ranger event timing motifs; do not assume assets or hooks exist.
archetypes.exit_invariant: No event flags, battle logic, AI or generic intro replacements; robust cleanup on skip/interruption.
